mode.system: Omit the attribute to follow the visitor's color scheme. Never pass a theme prop to components.

palette.target: html, or a container to theme one region
palette.default: Omit the attribute for the default palette.

default.label: Archive Teal
default.description: Deep teal primary and steel-blue secondary on cool mint surfaces. Calm and neutral; the root tokens.

tidal.label: Tidal Pool
tidal.description: Lagoon teal primary and terracotta coral secondary on pale aqua. Fresh and coastal.

sorbet.label: Sunset Sorbet
sorbet.description: Electric magenta primary and Capri cyan secondary on peach. Playful and loud.

orbit.label: Lunar Orbit
orbit.description: Ultraviolet primary and solar citron secondary on lavender. Futuristic and bold.

atelier.label: Cobalt Atelier
atelier.description: Klein cobalt primary and marigold secondary on ice blue. Confident and editorial.

canopy.label: Tropical Canopy
canopy.description: Malachite jade primary and neon orchid secondary on mint. Lush and energetic.

componentColor: A component's color prop names a semantic role (primary, secondary, success, error, warning, info, default, inherit). It is never a palette name or a CSS color.

overrides.brand: Override --clay-primary, --clay-primary-on (text on fill), and --clay-primary-ink (text on a surface) together. Check contrast in both modes. Do not set internal --c variables.
overrides.geometryTarget: Set on the surface element itself. Prefer a supported elevation, size or square prop before overriding CSS.
